**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | Allowlisted (tea bags are plastic-free) |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | Allowlisted |
| "Recommended by nutritionists" | Unsupported. Not on the allowlist, no source given. It is social proof and also a health-adjacent claim. |

**Problems**

1. "Recommended by nutritionists" is an invented endorsement. Nothing in the brand policy backs it, and it implies a health benefit, which can trip ad platform policy. Remove it. If a real nutritionist endorsement exists, supply the name, source and permission and it can go back in, but the landing page would also need to make it.

2. Landing page consistency: the ad's plastic-free and compostable claims are fine, provided the landing page makes them too. Worth confirming.

**Suggested compliant version**

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

Character counts: headline 22, description 83 (within standard 30 and 90 limits for search ads). Please confirm your limits if they differ.

Claims in the suggested version: plastic-free and home compostable (allowlisted); free UK delivery over £25 (allowlisted).
